children: The minutes from the RBA's September policy meeting on Tuesday are expected to confirm the decision to tighten policy last month was largely pre-emptive and a function of concerns around the inflation outlook, says Ben Jarman, chief economist at JP Morgan. Minutes from the prior meeting suggest inflation concerns remain multi-faceted. They include the Middle East conflict driving oil reserves lower and prices higher, a larger-than-expected AI/data-center investment boom, more resilient domestic demand and weaker-than-forecast productivity growth, he adds.
